changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add functional indexes to improve user management search performance
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_kc_user_username_lower ON admin_keycloak_user (lower(username))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_person_profile_account_lower ON person_profile (lower(account))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_person_profile_person_code_lower ON person_profile (lower(person_code))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_person_profile_external_id_lower ON person_profile (lower(external_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_role_member_username_lower ON admin_role_member (lower(username))
